results.title: One student sends the same claim 5 times at once
results.expected: 1 claim created; the rest refused with 409, no server errors
results.observed: claims created per item: Counter({1: 30}); responses: {409: 120, 201: 30}
results.note: The database index guarantees one open claim; the question is how the duplicates are answered.

results.title: Two guards approve two different claims on one item at once
One guard approves while another rejects the same claim
results.note: Two decisions mean the history shows both, the claimant may get both emails, and the final status is whichever wrote last.

results.title: Claimant withdraws at the moment a guard hands the item over
